scenario: [LTIM.4.1.1] / [LTIM.1.3.1]: `Time - Time` with the left operand the earlier is `0_s`, never a negative `Duration`. One W, `a` at 1 s and `b` at 6 s. Rule `saturates` fires where `w.a - w.b == 0_s`; rule `negative`, where `w.a - w.b < 0_s`, would fire on the unsaturated -5 s and must not; rule `render` logs `(w.a - w.b)::String`, `0s` and not `-5s`. Rule `unknown` fires where `w.a - w.c is null`: `c` is a `Time?` left absent, and a difference with a `null` operand stays `null` ([LNUL.4.1]) rather than faulting in the saturation. PATH PINNED: `dsc.rete`'s `rlow_6_1_6_saturating` lowering `Time - Time` to `FN_MAX(a - b, 0)` ([RLOW.6.1.6]), and `rlow_6_1_6_saturate`'s `null`-keeping form for the `Time?` operand; `FN_MAX` in libds (`builtin_max`) and Mercury (`ds.eval.pick`).
rules_ds:
schema W scope logical:
    id: Int key
    a: Time mutable
    b: Time mutable
    c: Time? mutable

rule saturates:
    W w where w.a - w.b == 0_s
->
    log info "zero"

rule negative:
    W w where w.a - w.b < 0_s
->
    log info "negative"

rule render:
    W w
->
    let d = (w.a - w.b)::String
    log info "d {d}"

rule unknown:
    W w where (w.a - w.c) is null
->
    log info "unknown"
